description: AGSC-02-11: an item is stale when stale_after is earlier than the build instant, by comparison only — no decay function, no activation score, no access log. Derivation: both values are AGSC-02-06 instants (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ), so their code-point order is their time order; with the build instant 2026-03-01T12:00:00Z the item whose stale_after is 2026-03-01T06:00:00Z is stale and the one whose stale_after is 2026-03-01T18:00:00Z is not — a comparison of the date alone would have called both stale or neither; an item with no stale_after is never stale, and an item whose stale_after equals the instant is not stale, since "earlier than" is strict. The stale list is sorted by slug in code-point order (AGSC-04-13).
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
